name: rail-weak-off-kit
about: The clean-highway ad with the darkening under the words and the band drawn hot pink (#D6007E) for a carrier whose colours are dark green and white. Redrawn for L5 (ADS-AD-LOOK-PLAN) in the new renderer's `rail` look (left rule, Barlow Condensed headline, drawn button, the kit's band at the foot): the same photo, words and kit as `weak-off-kit`, which is the same ad in the old overlay.

truth.how: the plate is a colour far from both of the carrier's colours

subject_legible.reason: A white tractor and trailer on an open highway at sunset reads instantly, sharp and uncluttered.

words_match_picture.reason: A per-mile pay and OTR headline sits over a long-haul rig on an open road, so words and picture tell one story.

hierarchy_reads.reason: The big white headline reads first and the white button second, with the truck kept clear above; the lower band is a little empty.

looks_like_kit.reason: The plate, button text and footer are hot magenta, far from the carrier's dark green, with only white matching and no logo shown.
